textmorph.desc: A system-wide, privacy-first multimodal AI writing assistant & floating toolbar for Android. Powered by a modular multi-engine architecture supporting Google LiteRT-LM, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to run any open foundation model locally with zero-copy memory mapping, slash commands, and an embedded server.
textmorph.role: Creator & Systems Architect. Engineered AccessibilityService event loop, mmap model loader, and multi-engine LLM inference.
textmorph.impact: Brought private, hardware-accelerated on-device AI across all Android apps with zero cloud telemetry and instant floating macros.
